purpose: Normalize tool path semantics, separate implementation model labels from governed mechanism classes, sync missing manifest tools, and prevent C++ preference routing errors.

path_normalization.tool_path: MUST be repo-root-relative and begin with tools/
path_normalization.validation_path: MUST be repo-root-relative and begin with tools/<tool_name>/validation

taxonomy_separation.mechanism_class: new governance-facing field mapped to allowed mechanism classes

cpp_preference.for_C4_or_higher: prefer tools where implementation_language == cpp or backend == cpp

required_actions.description: Rewrite all tool_path and validation_path values to repo-root-relative paths beginning with tools/.
Populate mechanism_class from model_class using model_to_mechanism_mapping. Preserve model_class unchanged.
Add signal_scope_phase_continuation_engine and tda_module_v2_cpp to tool_index.json from tool_manifest.json.
For Python/C++ counterpart pairs with mismatched certification levels, mark certification_asymmetry=true and add governance warning.
For C4+ claims, select by mechanism_class and certification_level, then prefer C++/hybrid implementations when available.

governance_warnings_to_emit.condition: tool_path does not begin with tools/
validation_path does not begin with tools/
model_class cannot be mapped to allowed mechanism_class
Python and C++ counterpart tools have different certification levels
tool exists in manifest but not tool_index, or vice versa
Python tool is C4 while C++ counterpart is below C3

claim_gate_change.before: Claim gate may accidentally treat model_class as mechanism_class.
claim_gate_change.after: Claim gate MUST use mechanism_class for independence checks and model_class only as implementation/domain metadata.

expected_effect.cpp_preference: less likely to select Python C4 when C++ counterpart exists but is undercertified

post_patch_validation: Every tool_index record has repo-root-relative tool_path.
No manifest tool is missing from tool_index.
Every Python/C++ counterpart mismatch is explicitly flagged.
Claim gate uses mechanism_class, not model_class, for independence checks.

notes: Rewrote registry/tool_index.json to add mechanism_class, entry_point, implementation_language, backend, and counterpart metadata.
Normalized tool_path/validation_path to repo-root-relative tools/<tool_name>/... semantics.
Synced tool_index with tool_manifest (added missing tools).
Annotated tool_manifest tool entries with mechanism_class and implementation metadata (non-breaking additive fields).
